`Check Changeset` is red on `6447f32ec` by design · `domain:devx` seat 1 · `session_012zwsLMxQBwHUYJgPyrpEvx` · 2026-10-13T05:24Z

- **The gate:** `Check Changeset` (`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`, with `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs`'s foreign-changeset rule).
  - This PR modifies two pending `.changeset/console-*.md` files and adds none.
  - That is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class. Both notes under-count the declared-breaking objectui entries they list, and they are corrected in place before the release freezes them.
- **Why it stays red:**
  - The workflow's own text says to "LEAVE THIS CHECK RED" (`pr-automation.yml:726`) and that these steps are "RED BY DESIGN on the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class" (`:938`).
  - `skip-changeset` would be a false declaration, because the notes are pending release text.
  - The check is not a required context on `main`. The required contexts are `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Lint & Repo Gates` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`.
  - `pr-automation.yml` runs on `pull_request` only, never on `merge_group`.
- **The written confirmation** the gate asks for is the contract-tier review on this head (`landing-operations.md:15`, the #22586 / PR #23126 precedent). It is in progress. Until it posts with PASS, this PR stays a draft.
- The seat's ACCEPT is on the card (#23136).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6447f32ece18795c874c50b4702ac9df8169edbe`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #23136 (body and all four comments; the claim `6138608503` and the ACCEPT `6138897436` were read for context and used as evidence for nothing), PR #23173 (body, file list, the net diff against `main` at `dc93781c1947b53cff50a550ad551e462a464594`, and its one comment `6138885636`), the 34 check-runs on the head, `origin/main` at `dc93781c1` in the shared checkout read-only (`git show`), both files at the head through the objectstack contents API at `6447f32ec`, and the twenty objectui changesets behind the twenty marked entries through the objectui contents API at each range's `to` commit. Nothing was built, run, re-run or ablated. This record is the written confirmation the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class asks for (`landing-operations.md:15-16`): it names both edited notes and judges every rewritten line, the two count lines and the ten entry lines, each against what objectui declared.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set and public-surface changes implied by the diff: none.** The compare `dc93781c1...6447f32ec` is one commit, two files, both `modified`, +12 / -12: `.changeset/console-20c6d351ad74.md` (+5 / -5) and `.changeset/console-f0268ad78485.md` (+7 / -7). Zero added, zero deleted; no path under `packages/`, `examples/`, `content/`, no `.changeset/pre.json`, no `CHANGELOG.md`, no workflow, no governed surface. Both notes are unconsumed on `origin/main` (`.changeset/pre.json` is `mode: pre`, `tag: next`), so the diff changes only the text `changeset version` will compile into `@objectstack/console`'s CHANGELOG; it moves no schema, export, option or refusal. Every one of the 12 changed lines is in the digest-written entry list or its count line; no hunk reaches the frontmatter or the adr-0087 HTML comment block of either file.

**Note 1 — `.changeset/console-20c6d351ad74.md`** (objectui range `47b1f0bb7174...20c6d351ad74`; line numbers are the same at base and head because no line is added or removed). Each entry line differs from its base only by the inserted `**BREAKING** — ` after `- **minor** — `, the shape the file's base already uses at `:17`, `:18`, `:20`; the entry text and its objectui sha are unchanged.

- `:12`, objectui `8a55f0ccd` (sidebar reorder retired). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/12059-sidebar-no-reorder.md:9` at `20c6d351ad74` opens "**`@object-ui/layout` (breaking, declared `minor` per the version policy).** `NavigationRenderer` retires `enableReorder` and `onReorder`, …". A bold lead label whose parenthetical opens with "breaking": the author's own breaking annotation.
- `:13`, objectui `c7b30bd66` (`UnifiedViewConfig.chart` retired). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/12063-unified-view-config-chart-retired.md:9` at `20c6d351ad74` opens "**Retired (breaking), `@object-ui/types`.** `UnifiedViewConfig.chart` declared the list-view chart's …".
- `:16`, objectui `025341692` (chart list view binds only a dataset). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/6152-list-view-legacy-chart-retired.md:13` at `20c6d351ad74` opens "**Changed (breaking for a stored chart view that names no `dataset`).** Every door refuses the …".
- `:19`, objectui `3fd862510` (renderers stop reading refused list-view keys). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/6152-list-view-readers-retired.md:14` at `20c6d351ad74` opens "**Changed (breaking for a stored view that carries a refused key).** Rounds 11 and 12 of …".
- `:43`, the count line, "⚠️ 10 of these carry a breaking change: 10 by the author's own breaking annotation in the changeset body — objectui declares no `major` …" (was 6 / 6; the rest of the sentence is unchanged). **TRUE.** Counted on the head text: 33 entry lines (the file's own "33 releasing"), 10 of them carrying the marker; the sha `d32869883` is two entry lines, both marked at base and unchanged. The six marked at base are unchanged and each carries the author's annotation at `20c6d351ad74`: `7282c6a51` (`12055-upload-path-not-scope.md:11`, "BREAKING (`@object-ui/providers`), for a caller …"), `1f1c4b526` (`6349-batch6-plugin-designer.md:7`, "**Breaking-change note.** …"), `e4c0b5432` (`5250-strict-validate-wiring.md:13`, "**Breaking for documents that carry an undeclared key.** …"), `3c3115e38` (`5144-editinline-fold.md:10`, "**Breaking for a view that relied on the old default.** …"), `d32869883` (`6349-batch4-core.md:7` and `6349-batch4-types.md:7`, "**Type changes, breaking for some consumers.**"). Ten marked, ten annotated. What objectui declared over the range is the card's instrument reading, the digest as repaired by PR #23131: "10, over `47b1f0bb7174..20c6d351ad74`" (card body table), and the ten entries it names are exactly the four above plus the six already marked. "None by a declared `major`": the ten changesets' frontmatters at `20c6d351ad74` declare `minor` and `patch` only. Limit stated: a read-only review runs no digest, so "no eleventh" rests on the card's instrument reading; every entry the note marks is verified here against objectui's own text.

**Note 2 — `.changeset/console-f0268ad78485.md`** (objectui range `a58626c88dc8...f0268ad78485`). Same shape: each entry line differs from its base only by the inserted `**BREAKING** — `, as the base already writes at `:19`, `:24`, `:27`.

- `:10`, objectui `5d77c099b` (list view `options` bag by reference). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/6152-list-view-options-bag.md:12` at `f0268ad78485` opens "**Narrowed (breaking), `@object-ui/types`.** `@objectstack/spec`'s authoring list view declares no …".
- `:13`, objectui `cf62edf68` (kanban / calendar / gallery / timeline blocks strict). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/6152-list-view-blocks-strict.md:9` at `f0268ad78485` opens "**Narrowed (breaking).** `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 judges each per-view-type block of a list view as …".
- `:17`, objectui `b13ea3c67` (`defaultFilters` and the flat gantt / map `filter`). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/6152-grid-default-filters-gantt-map-filter.md:26` at `f0268ad78485` is "**Narrowed (breaking).**".
- `:21`, objectui `1473757bf` (`object-calendar` container strict). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/6152-object-calendar-container-strict.md:9` at `f0268ad78485` opens "**Narrowed (breaking).** `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 types `ComponentPropsMap['object-calendar'].calendar` …".
- `:22`, objectui `d7e9e9ab6` (`object-grid` `operations` and the grid / kanban / calendar `filter`). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/6152-grid-kanban-calendar-17-7-members.md:14` at `f0268ad78485` opens "**Narrowed (breaking).** `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 types `object-grid`'s `operations` as the …".
- `:29`, objectui `d73d98770` (`resizableColumns` retired). **TRUE.** objectui `.changeset/6152-resizable-columns-retired.md:8` at `f0268ad78485` opens "**Retired (breaking).** `resizableColumns` was the legacy second spelling of `resizable` on …".
- `:111`, the count line, "⚠️ 10 of these carry a breaking change: 10 by the author's own breaking annotation …" (was 4 / 4; the rest unchanged). **TRUE.** Counted on the head text: 100 listed entry lines (the list is capped at 100 of 173; `:109` "…and 73 more"), 10 carrying the marker, so every marked entry sits inside the cap. The four marked at base are unchanged and each carries the author's annotation at `f0268ad78485`: `18d7b489c` (`11070-form-field-scale-currency-config.md:14`, "BREAKING (`@object-ui/types`), for a document whose form field …"), `172acc313` (`11070-sidebar-side.md:13`, "BREAKING (`@object-ui/types`), for a document whose `sidebar` node …"), `d92b2a15d` (`11389-retire-metric-subcaption.md:7`, "… **BREAKING** for any dashboard that drew a caption …"), `74add0c12` (`11880-element-datasource-only.md:13`, "Breaking for an author who wrote the flat keys …"). Ten marked, ten annotated; the card's instrument reading over this range is "10, over `a58626c88dc8..f0268ad78485`", naming exactly these six plus the four. "None by a declared `major`": the ten frontmatters at `f0268ad78485` declare `minor` and `patch` only. The same limit as note 1 applies to "no eleventh".

**Invariants the card and the triage grade set, measured base vs head on both files** (md5 of the extracted lines, `origin/main` copy against the head copy read through the contents API):
- adr-0087 HTML comment block byte-identical: `console-20c6d351ad74.md:49-90` (42 lines) `4d8165bda53cc2211ebc873b21a0dc8a` at both; `console-f0268ad78485.md:120-152` (33 lines) `e503fdd7341c8ee1378fe8214dd7afbd` at both. Exactly one `adr-0087:` marker per file at both revisions, at `:49` and `:120`, each reading `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
- Frontmatter byte-identical: `console-20c6d351ad74.md:1-5` `1ba65378c24899139039c00d9bc33521` at both; `console-f0268ad78485.md:1-5` `597f9211ce3ad8e4febaa4185db37984` at both. Both declare `"@objectstack/console": minor`, unchanged. (The dev's `7f9512…` reading covered a different line window; the equality is what matters and it holds under this window too.)
- The bump was not re-run: the diff is exactly the twelve lines above and nothing else; the pin line (`:5`), the "Derived from the changesets …" line (`:7`), the "declared nowhere" paragraph, the objectui range lines and every unmarked entry are byte-identical. No raw ASCII control byte in either head file.

**Check-runs on `6447f32ece18795c874c50b4702ac9df8169edbe`: 34, all completed; 25 success, 8 skipped, 1 failure.** Success includes the five required contexts' carriers that run on this diff: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, and every `Lint ·` / `Type Check ·` slice (`source gates`, `workspace`, `debt ledger`, `consumer gates`, `PM dispatch-gates`, `ESLint`, `tooling self-tests`, …), plus `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path`, `Part-of PR must not also close its card`, `Check PR Size`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Auto Label`, `filter`. Skipped by the path filter (no package source; `ci.yml:2395` `needs.filter.outputs.core != 'false'`, an expected-skip row in `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs:273`): `Build Core` (the fifth required context), the sharded `Test Core` and `Dogfood Regression Gate` matrices, `Console Pin Gate`, `Build Docs`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `Packed-tarball smoke`. The one failure is `Check Changeset`, red by design on this class, the three conditions of SKILL.md `:206-207` each standing: (a) the source on the branch says so (`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml:720-726`, "If every row is `M` or `D` and none is `A` … CORRECTING somebody else's PENDING release note … do NOT apply 'skip-changeset' … LEAVE THIS CHECK RED", and `:936-940`, "RED BY DESIGN on the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class"; the PR touches no workflow, so the branch's copy is `origin/main`'s); (b) the workflow runs on `pull_request`, never `merge_group`, and `Check Changeset` is none of the five required contexts; (c) the PR comment `6138885636` records the gate and the reason. The run's own annotation names this route: "if its only .changeset rows are CHANGED, not added, this PR corrects somebody else's pending release note -- do NOT apply 'skip-changeset'; write the confirmation on the PR, naming the note and what changed under it, and leave this check red". The file list confirms the class: 2 `modified`, 0 added. `mergeable_state: unstable` follows from that one red. This record is the written confirmation.

### ② Semver level

- The PR adds no changeset: correct. It publishes nothing new; it corrects the pending declarations of two objectui pin bumps already on `main`, and only their compiled text changes.
- `skip-changeset` is absent (labels `documentation`, `size/s`, `tooling`): correct and required. The notes are pending release text, and the workflow's own route for this class bars the label (`pr-automation.yml:724`).
- Bump level unchanged: both frontmatters byte-identical, `"@objectstack/console": minor`. The adr-0087 disposition of each note is byte-identical and `check-adr-0087-registration` reads both as inherited (breaking already at the merge base; `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:4825-4843`), so nothing new is owed to that gate or to `check-changeset-no-major`; both ride inside the green `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- `Clause-②: no (published changelog text; no accept set or public surface widens)`, line 2 of the PR body: correct. The diff widens no accept set and no public surface; the parenthetical is reasoning, not an arm (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs:291-292` reads it as `arm: null`), so the declaration is well-formed. Neither note carries a `Clause-②` line of its own, at base or head, and none is owed by a pin-bump note.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `6138850179`, every flag and the one `open_questions` entry answered:

1. **`open_questions` 1 — route an update to the two adr-0087 disposition narratives, which now count fewer than the list (A leave / B separate narrative-only correction / C drop the per-entry answers)?** Answer for THIS head: nothing is owed, and the verdict does not hang on it. The card's done-criteria and the triage grade `6137918853` hold the disposition blocks byte-identical, and they are (md5 above). The blocks' verdict line, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, is read by category, not by count: that category refuses only a body carrying a migration prescription and requires no per-entry answer, and both narratives already scope their claim in their own closing sentence (`console-20c6d351ad74.md:88-89`, `console-f0268ad78485.md:150-151`: "a claim about THIS diff, not a per-entry re-measurement of the upstream declared-breaking entries"). The category also survives the ten newly marked entries on their own text: all ten are objectui `@object-ui/types` / `plugin-list` / `layout` narrowings and retirements that follow `@objectstack/spec` declarations already on this tree. The 20c6 narrative says so by name for three of its four (`:80-85`, `3fd862510`, `025341692`, `c7b30bd66`, "They follow this repo's existing declarations"), and the f026 narrative states the governing principle for the other six (`:146-149`: the ledger entries belong to the `packages/spec` PR, never to the pin bump). Measured here from the entries' declaring text and the narratives' own stated principle, not as a per-entry re-measurement of the tree. Not a FAIL item. **Escalated, to the triage seat:** the sentences "The range carries six declared-breaking objectui changes … Each is answered here" (`:60-61`) and "four …" (`:130-131`) are now false against the count lines above them and ship verbatim in the raw `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md`, the text an upgrading agent greps (AGENTS.md, Documentation Guardrails). Correcting them reopens the byte-identical ruling, which takes a triage word, not this record's. My reading for that word: B, a separate DELIBERATE CORRECTION card on `domain:devx` that edits the narrative count sentence and adds one measured line per newly marked entry, verdict line unchanged, before 18.0 GA; C deletes answers that are measured and true; A leaves a known false count sentence in published text. ⛔ Not on this PR, and not a condition of this PASS.
2. **Deviation 1 — the relay's `--route` re-exec notice prints the value of `HTTPS_PROXY`.** Confirmed as the tool's own text: `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs:483` interpolates the proxy URL into its "unrouted" reason. The dev printed the variable's name only in the report, which is the right form. Not a contract matter for this PR; a tooling observation for the seat, filed by nobody here.
3. **Deviation 2 — `dispatch-gates --commands` run in its no-path form.** Accepted: the derivation from the merge base and the compare API read the same two paths, so the family set is the one the dispatch intended.
4. **Deviation 3 — commit trailers are AGENTS.md's model-free pair, not the harness reminder's.** Correct per AGENTS.md (Multi-agent discipline, the commit-message rule); the head commit's message carries exactly that pair and no model identifier.
5. **NOT MEASURED — the four type-check lanes.** Measured by the head's check-runs: `Type Check · source gates`, `· workspace`, `· debt ledger`, `· consumer gates` all `success`. Closed.
6. **Out-of-scope finding — `check-adr-0087-registration`'s pass line counts inherited-breaking skips as "non-breaking changeset(s) seen".** Holds: both the non-breaking branch (`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:4823`) and the inherited-breaking branch (`:4843`) push into the same `skipped` list, and the pass line (`:8821`) prints `skipped.length` under the non-breaking label. Internal summary text with no public door; the dev recorded it in the PR's Acceptance notes. The seat's call whether to file; my reading is that it qualifies under Prime Directive #10 as a reproducible defect with a named landing point (one line), so a small `tooling` card is the cleaner route. Not a FAIL item.

No escalation to the maintainer is owed by this record beyond what the landing rules already reserve: the PR is not governed (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; no `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` or `.github/workflows/**` path), the head repo is the base repo, and `Check Changeset` stays red by design. With this record on the head, the three conditions for carrying that red into the queue stand (SKILL.md `:206-207`), and the ready / arm acts are the owning seat's.
